lines.zh: 我不会跳，只能一步一步挪。
lines.en: I can't hop; I just shuffle step by step.
The sand burns my feet; I walk faster.

lines.zh: 四只脚踩下去，沙子就埋住我半截。
lines.en: Four steps in and the sand half-buries me.

lines.zh: 我拖着肚子走，像块湿石头。
lines.en: I drag my belly along like a wet stone.

lines.zh: 雨点打在身上，我才敢出来。
lines.en: Only when rain hits me do I dare come out.

lines.zh: 前面有个水洼，我绕着走。
lines.en: A puddle ahead — I go around it.

lines.zh: 我不擅长游泳，别把我扔水里。
lines.en: I'm a poor swimmer; don't drop me in water.

lines.zh: 走两步，我就想往沙里钻。
lines.en: Two steps in and I want to burrow.

lines.zh: 沙面下的凉气，从脚底传上来。
lines.en: Cool air under the sand rises through my feet.

lines.zh: 阴天的沙漠，才像我住的地方。
lines.en: A desert under cloud feels like home.

lines.zh: 别踩这条线，那是我走出来的。
lines.en: Don't step on that line; I made it.
A string of little pits trails behind me.

lines.zh: 太远了，我得歇一歇再走。
lines.en: Too far — I need a rest before more.

lines.zh: 沙丘那边的雨声更响，我去看看。
lines.en: Rain sounds louder past the dune; I'll look.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙脊走，那里风小。
lines.en: I keep to the lee of the sand ridge.

lines.zh: 湿沙比干沙好走，我挑湿的。
lines.en: Wet sand walks better. I pick the wet parts.
Don't step in the puddle ahead of me.

lines.zh: 圆身子一蹦，雨就跟着来。
lines.en: One hop of this round body, and the rain comes.
I called the rain. Keep up.
Don't hurry me, I'm hopping toward the rain.

lines.zh: 唱片一放，我就跳求雨舞。
lines.en: Put on a record and I dance for rain.

lines.zh: 唱片一转，我就开始跳舞。
lines.en: The record spins and I start to dance.
This sand flat is hot under my feet.
Hop by hop, I'll get there.

lines.zh: 我蹦一下，还没一块石头高。
lines.en: One hop, and I am still shorter than a stone.

lines.zh: 雨点一落，我的皮肤就润了。
lines.en: One raindrop and my skin drinks.
One hop, then wait for a rainstorm.
One hop around the puddle, then another.
Tired of hopping, I lick the dew.

lines.zh: 雨后泥地软，我的脚趾好走。
lines.en: After rain the mud is soft under my toes.
Looking around for somewhere damp.

lines.zh: 我这么小，一步才挪一指。
lines.en: I am tiny; one step is a finger's width.

lines.zh: 我埋进沙里，只露一对眼睛。
lines.en: I sink into the sand, leaving just my eyes.

lines.zh: 沙粒卡在背上，我抖一抖。
lines.en: Grains stuck on my back; I shake them off.
I'm waiting for the next rain.
Once the sun's out, I must hide.

lines.zh: 我不产蝌蚪，孩子生下来就是小的我。
lines.en: I make no tadpoles; my young come out as small me.

lines.zh: 有只蚂蚁路过，我看看就好。
lines.en: An ant passes by; I'll just watch.

lines.zh: 喉咙鼓起来，再慢慢瘪下去。
lines.en: My throat swells, then slowly sinks.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤颜色跟沙子一样。
lines.en: My skin is the same color as the sand.

lines.zh: 沙下面比上面凉快多了。
lines.en: Under the sand is far cooler than above.
Don't dig me up with a shovel; it startles me.

lines.zh: 我眨了眨眼，把沙挤出去。
lines.en: I blink to work the sand out.

lines.zh: 这片阴天能撑多久，我就待多久。
lines.en: As long as this cloud lasts, so do I.
I count ants and wait for rain.

lines.zh: 唱片一响，我就要跳舞求雨。
lines.en: When the record plays, I dance for rain.

lines.zh: 泥里打个滚，我的皮就湿了。
lines.en: One roll in mud keeps my skin wet.
The record isn't playing yet, let's wait.
I squat, waiting for clouds to gather.
The record stopped and the rain never came.
The record plays, and my legs start moving.
The record plays and I start to dance.

lines.zh: 唱片一转，我就要跳舞求雨。
lines.en: One record spins, and I dance for rain.
A little bug crawls over my eyelid.
Mud and water — that's enough.

lines.zh: 我跳到荷叶上，等着下雨。
lines.en: I hop onto a lily pad and wait for rain.
Did I forget to lick the dew?
Who's calling? Only the rain.
The cloud drifted off, and the rain with it.

lines.zh: 雨蛙蹲在叶子上，先不动。
lines.en: Sitting on a leaf, holding still for now.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，比站着好看清。
lines.en: Crouch down; I can see you better.

lines.zh: 你靴子上有沙子，跟我一样。
lines.en: Sand on your boots — same as me.

lines.zh: 我不是石头，别拿脚试我。
lines.en: I'm not a stone; don't nudge me with your foot.

lines.zh: 你手里是虫子吗？我看不清。
lines.en: Is that a bug in your hand? I can't tell.
You're blocking the rain — thank you.

lines.zh: 我鼓起身子，是想显得大一点。
lines.en: I puff up so I look bigger than I am.
Don't reach out; I'll squeal.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在沙上，凉快。
lines.en: Your shadow on the sand is cool.

lines.zh: 我盯你很久了，你才发现。
lines.en: I've watched you a while; you just noticed.
Leaving already? The rain hasn't stopped.
Your boots are sinking into wet sand.
I call, and the clouds gather.
When the record plays, I want to call rain.

lines.zh: 这片水洼以前没见过你。
lines.en: These puddles haven't seen you before.
When the record plays, I must dance.

lines.zh: 你口袋里有小虫的味道。
lines.en: Your pocket smells of little bugs.
Don't pinch my back, my skin is thin.

lines.zh: 别盯着我，我皮肤还湿着。
lines.en: Don't stare, my skin is still wet.

lines.zh: 你手里那片唱片，会下雨吗？
lines.en: Will that record in your hand bring rain?
Crouch down, I can't lift my head that high.

lines.zh: 原来是你，鞋底还在滴水。
lines.en: Oh, it's you, still dripping from your boots.
Got any bugs in that hand? Let me see.

lines.zh: 我鼓起身子，叫得整片沙都响。
lines.en: I puff up and squeal loud enough to shake the sand.

lines.zh: 这一下把我从沙里打出来了。
lines.en: That knocked me right out of the sand.

lines.zh: 我的皮薄，经不起第二下。
lines.en: My skin is thin; I can't take a second.

lines.zh: 我翻过来了，帮我翻回去。
lines.en: I'm on my back; help me turn over.
Not the shovel; it startles me into scrambling.
My legs are numb; I can't walk.
That stings far more than hot sand.
I curl into a ball and pass for a stone.

lines.zh: 叫声卡在喉咙里，出不来了。
lines.en: The squeal is stuck in my throat.
I'm going under the sand; don't pull me.
One record and the rain comes.
A roll in the mud and it stops hurting.
My skin is thin; one touch hurts.
The rain hasn't come and I already got hit.
Who stepped on my wet back?
I don't cry, I just puff up.
It's nothing... really.
The rain hasn't come — I'll remember you.
Don't step closer, I'm shrinking back.
My skin's thin as paper.
That maggot wriggles; I can see it clearly.
Where there's a bug, I follow.
Lower it a bit; I can't reach.
Maggots will do, and small bugs too.

lines.zh: 我从沙里爬出来了，别收走。
lines.en: I've climbed out of the sand — don't take it away.
That smell pulls harder than the rain does.
I'll shuffle over; I don't hop.

lines.zh: 给我一条，我就在这儿吃。
lines.en: Give me one and I'll eat right here.
For breeding, the maggots come first.
The bug in your hand is still moving.
That beetle — spare me half.
Let me sniff the bug in your hand.
Hold the bug, I'll hop behind.
When I dance, the rain comes.
Don't pull back, the bug is still moving.
You know I love live bugs.

lines.zh: 唱片一响，我就跳起来求雨。
lines.en: When the record plays, I dance for rain.
That leaf — I've stared too long.
Finally raining. The sand is soft again.
Small as I am, my voice is not.
This bug tastes like rain.
One more — can I have it?
This smells better than mud bugs.
Steady now, the bug will bolt.
Walk slower, my legs are short.
My mouth is already getting sticky.
You stepped on me; I'm in the sand.

lines.zh: 我被撞得翻了个身，起不来。
lines.en: The bump flipped me over; I can't right myself.
I'm tiny; watch where you walk.

lines.zh: 别推，我刚从沙里爬出来。
lines.en: Don't push; I just crawled out.

lines.zh: 这一下把我埋得更深了。
lines.en: That buried me even deeper.

lines.zh: 我鼓起来了，你先退半步。
lines.en: I'm puffing up; step back half a pace.

lines.zh: 沙子进了嘴，我吐了半天。
lines.en: Sand got in my mouth; I spat for ages.

lines.zh: 你鞋底比我整个身子还宽。
lines.en: Your sole is wider than my whole body.

lines.zh: 撞完你才发现，我一直在那儿。
lines.en: Only after bumping did you notice I was there.
I'll shift over a little and let you pass.

lines.zh: 你的脚掌压住我的脚趾。
lines.en: You stepped on my toes.
Your boot is harder than stone.

lines.zh: 撞得我眼冒星星，地都在转。
lines.en: Knocked stars into my eyes; the ground spins.
What's the rush? I can't hop fast.

lines.zh: 我这嗓子，能叫来整场雨。
lines.en: This throat of mine can call a whole storm.
One note from the jukebox and I start to dance
Careful, my back is bumpy.
One bump and I flip over.
Your knee caught my back.
One hop from me and the rain falls.
You're waiting for rain too? Let's wait together.

lines.zh: 我们并排埋在沙里，谁也看不见。
lines.en: Buried side by side, neither of us is seen.

lines.zh: 你的叫声比我的低一点。
lines.en: Your call is a little lower than mine.
Half the maggots for you — don't grab.

lines.zh: 雨停了，我们各自钻回沙里。
lines.en: When the rain stops, we each go back under.

lines.zh: 孩子的皮肤也会是沙色。
lines.en: The little ones will be sand-colored too.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我容易鼓起来。
lines.en: Not too close; I puff up easily.
This rain will last; no hurry.
You shift a step, I shift a step.

lines.zh: 明年下雨，还在这片沙丘。
lines.en: Next rain, same dune.
The rain hasn't stopped; stay a while.

lines.zh: 唱片机一响，我就要跳舞求雨。
lines.en: When the jukebox plays, I dance for rain.
Rain's coming. Will you stay?
Forehead to forehead, listening to rain.
Let's crouch under the leaf together.
The rain falls, and we are well matched.
I saved the fattest bug for you.
Come closer, my voice is small.
My dance is a prayer for rain.
Follow me, the mud is soft over there.

lines.zh: 这只虫子掉了翅膀，我捡走。
lines.en: This bug lost a wing; I'll take it.
Something on the ground — I'll taste it.

lines.zh: 我叼不住太多，一次一只。
lines.en: I can't hold much — one at a time.
What I turn up in the sand is mine.

lines.zh: 这东西比虫子硬，咬不动。
lines.en: This is harder than a bug; I can't bite it.
I pin it with a front foot and eat slowly.
Don't laugh; my mouth is small.
This maggot will last me half a day.
Once I've got it, back into the sand.
Crumbs you drop — I won't turn them down.

lines.zh: 六点血的小蛙，也想收藏。
lines.en: A six-point frog still wants a collection.
Whose bug is this? Mine now.
This beetle shell is too hard for my teeth.
This little thing. I will hold it in my mouth.
My mouth was empty, perfect for carrying.

lines.zh: 叼回去，喂沙里的小家伙。
lines.en: I'll carry it back to the little ones in the sand.
One more pebble for my little pit.

lines.zh: 我蹲在苔藓里，你看不见。
lines.en: I crouch in moss. You can't see me.
It dropped right by my puddle.
Too hard, I can't chew this.
The sand shifted — there's a bug.

lines.zh: 有只小虫在爬，我盯住了。
lines.en: A small bug crawls; I've fixed on it.
There's a wingbeat over there.
I turn my head slowly so it isn't spooked.

lines.zh: 目标不远，就在那块石头旁。
lines.en: The target's close, by that stone.

lines.zh: 沙里的动静，我听得最清。
lines.en: Movement in sand is what I hear best.

lines.zh: 它往阴影里去了，我跟上。
lines.en: It went into the shade; I follow.

lines.zh: 我先埋好身子，只露眼睛。
lines.en: I bury myself first, eyes only.
The bug has stopped — good.

lines.zh: 这个距离，我挪过去够得到。
lines.en: At this distance I can shuffle within reach.

lines.zh: 风把气味送过来，是虫子。
lines.en: The wind brings a smell — bugs.

lines.zh: 我不跳，但我能等到它靠近。
lines.en: I don't hop, but I can wait for it to come.
Today I feel like biting something.
Don't touch my bug pit.

lines.zh: 我要把身子埋进沙里藏好。
lines.en: I need to bury myself in the sand.
Puff up, then leap.
One record spins, and the rain comes.
Closer and I'll jump at your shoe.

lines.zh: 唱片机一响，雨就跟着来。
lines.en: One record spins and the rain follows.

lines.zh: 你把我那摊雨水踩散了。
lines.en: You trampled my puddle.
Raindrops are my drumbeat.
This time I won't dive back into sand.

lines.zh: 再近一点，我舌头就够到。
lines.en: A little closer and my tongue reaches.

lines.zh: 它没发现我，我埋在沙里。
lines.en: It hasn't spotted me; I'm under the sand.

lines.zh: 我数着它的脚，一步、两步。
lines.en: I count its steps — one, two.
Hold still; I'm almost lined up.

lines.zh: 沙子硌着我的肚子，忍一忍。
lines.en: Sand grates my belly; I'll endure it.
It goes left; I drift that way.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛一直没离开它。
lines.en: My eyes haven't left it once.

lines.zh: 这个角度不好，我绕半圈。
lines.en: Bad angle; I'll go half a circle round.

lines.zh: 它停在我够得到的地方了。
lines.en: It's stopped within my reach.
I hold my breath and keep my throat still.
Almost — one body length to go.
It's about to fly; I must be quicker.

lines.zh: 你跑到干地上也得回来。
lines.en: Run to dry ground and you'll still come back.
Short legs: three hops to your one step.

lines.zh: 我一鼓肚皮，雨点就下来了。
lines.en: One puff of my belly and the rain comes.
After this dance, the rain comes.
I hear the rain. Do you?

lines.zh: 唱片一转，我就跳起来了。
lines.en: The record spins and I start to dance.

lines.zh: 这片雨林的水洼，我全认得。
lines.en: I know every puddle in this rainforest.
One hop from me and the rain is close.
I follow along the wet mud.
There's no puddle past that sand slope.

lines.zh: 我咬一口，然后立刻松口。
lines.en: I bite once, then let go at once.
Small as I am, I do have teeth.
That was for whoever stepped on me.
I headbutt you — not a bite.

lines.zh: 沙里打不了架，我只会撞。
lines.en: I can't fight in sand; I only shove.
After biting, I dive into the sand.
Reach in and I puff up.

lines.zh: 我这一口，连虫子都嫌轻。
lines.en: My bite is light even by bug standards.

lines.zh: 打不过，我就装成一块沙。
lines.en: If I'm losing, I become a lump of sand.

lines.zh: 别逼我，我会叫得很大声。
lines.en: Don't push me; I'll squeal very loud.
The rain hasn't come. This is a warning.
I leap and ram with my head.

lines.zh: 我没有牙，只有一肚子气。
lines.en: No teeth, just a belly full of air.

lines.zh: 得等雨后，我才有这个胆。
lines.en: Only after rain do I have this nerve.
I can hurt you with a jump too.
After the bump I dive back into sand.
A wet headbutt to your ankle.
My skin has to stay wet.
One step back and I just puff up.
Don't jump, I can't reach high.
It's raining; I come out of the sand.

lines.zh: 这片沙漠今天有云，正好。
lines.en: Cloud over the desert today — just right.

lines.zh: 我先钻出半个头，看看四周。
lines.en: I poke half my head out and look around.

lines.zh: 沙子是湿的，走路不扬尘。
lines.en: The sand is damp; my steps raise no dust.
Rain on my back wakes me.

lines.zh: 太阳一露头，我就得回去。
lines.en: The moment the sun shows, I go back under.

lines.zh: 这地方没有蝌蚪，也没有池塘。
lines.en: No tadpoles here, and no pond either.

lines.zh: 我抖掉身上的沙，开始找虫。
lines.en: I shake off the sand and start hunting bugs.

lines.zh: 阴天难得，我多待一会儿。
lines.en: A cloudy day is rare; I'll stay a while.

lines.zh: 我埋得太久，腿都有点僵。
lines.en: Buried so long, my legs are stiff.
In the mud, I croak once first.
I hop toward whatever sounds like water.
It was stuffy under the sand for ages.

lines.zh: 我这么小，一片叶子就够躲。
lines.en: I'm small; one leaf hides me.

lines.zh: 钻出沙面，光晃得我眯眼。
lines.en: Out of the sand, the light makes me squint.

lines.zh: 唱片一响，我就要跳舞了。
lines.en: One note of music and I start to dance.
The first raindrop just hit my back.
Just out of the soil, my legs still shake.
Croak — my voice still comes out clear.

lines.zh: 太阳太毒，我得找片叶子。
lines.en: The sun is harsh; I need a leaf.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤一烤就干，别点火。
lines.en: My skin dries fast in heat — no flames.
Stay back — the rain hasn't fallen.

lines.zh: 从沙丘上滚下去，翻了四圈。
lines.en: Down the dune I rolled, four turns over.
Bones fine. Pride isn't.
Water past my belly and I panic.
I asked for rain — this is too much.

lines.zh: 气浪把沙子和我一起掀起来。
lines.en: The blast lifted sand and me together.
The blast flipped me head over heels.

lines.zh: 一支箭插在我旁边的沙里。
lines.en: An arrow stands in the sand beside me.
An arrow sank into my wet skin.

lines.zh: 咒语让我的皮肤变了颜色。
lines.en: The spell changed the color of my skin.
Those words make my skin tighten.

lines.zh: 三天没虫，我连叫的劲都没了。
lines.en: Three days without bugs and I can't even squeal.
Empty belly; I need a bug.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，沙子变成了玻璃。
lines.en: Lightning struck and the sand turned to glass.
Lightning hit my back; I can't hop.
The sand is gone; nothing under my feet.
No mud here, no rain either.
